basics.name: Shreya L. Ramachandran
basics.summary: Computational biologist, metagenomics specialist, and Fulbright alumna with a proven record of leading international, multidisciplinary infectious disease and microbiome research with diverse communities. Postdoctoral Fellow and MPH student (Epidemiology and Global Health) at the University of Chicago.

work.summary: Supported by TL1 Fellowship in Clinical Research, Biomedical Informatics, and Health Equity (NIH/NCATS); studying the evolution of Fusobacterium nucleatum and its association with colorectal cancer epidemiology.
Studied the genomic history of Afro-Mexicans and shared results with participants from marginalized communities.

work.company: Stanford Department of Psychiatry / VA Palo Alto
work.summary: Conducted neurocognitive and sleep assessments; served as Spanish interpreter for participant families.
